checks_run.command: tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project integration apps/api/test/integration/operations/concurrent-exception-recurrence.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/operations/exception-recurrence-race.test.ts; sed mutant on apps/api/src/modules/operations/exceptions.ts and apps/worker/src/kit.ts, then git checkout
checks_run.expected: The ADR text matches the code. The tests pass, and the mutant fails them.
checks_run.actual: (a) Every stated rule matches the code; see the verifications sidecar. F-DG6-341 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. (b) Exit 0, 14/14. The mutant exited 1 by design: all 7 F-DG6-380 tests failed (the 4 bursts and the 3 early-start/microsecond cases), and the files were restored. (c) Accepted. The UPDATE runs after lock 730305 and the FOR UPDATE read in a READ COMMITTED transaction, so the SET expression reads the latest committed row. greatest(now(), column) never moves backwards. occurrence_count steps by exactly 1 under WHERE version = locked version, so no occurrence is lost or double-counted. A real backwards move still raises check_violation. That is the intent of the 0101 guard.

checks_run.procedure: Judge D-194 to D-196, D-199 item 2, D-202 and D-203 to D-205 against the master prompt's automation and integration clauses and the playbook's operating logic.
checks_run.command: read docs/delivery/decisions.md D-194..D-216; ADR-0043 amendments ARCH-09/ARCH-10 (E2, G1-G4); apps/worker/src/automation/engine.ts candidates
checks_run.expected: Each decision is accepted or raised as a finding.
checks_run.actual: Accepted: D-194 (start after DG5 APPROVED), D-195 (the plan; Q3 sensitive aggregates labelled; Q5/Q6/Q7/Q8 residuals disclosed, not claimed delivered), D-196 (403 for an in-scope reader without parent admission, 404 otherwise, matching the REQ-S13-013 text), D-199 item 2, and D-202 (pre-freeze repairs, none accepted as an observation). D-203 to D-205 are accepted as well. A rule acts only on events that occurred while it was enabled, so enabling a rule never replays history. A late event is evaluated against the version in force at its occurrence, from the append-only ledger, so a backlog at a publish is not silently dropped. A rule disabled now stops its pending events, an operator kill switch. Exactly-once holds: one execution per rule version and trigger key, plus action keys. This meets REQ-S20-013 (no duplicated approvals, measurements or notifications; failed jobs recoverable; A13 passed in my run). The commit-order residual race (a publish or enable that starts before an event but commits after its evaluation) is bounded by evaluation lag. It never acts for a rule that was not enabled at occurrence, and it is documented in ADR-0043 G4, so I accept it as documented. No automation decision grants a business approval.

summary: FAIL on candidate 0fea8adf (2743 files, source 031945d87). Both of my open findings are CLOSED_VERIFIED. F-DG6-340: the round-5 reproduction now shows the TL's totals section flagged, and a mutant that reverts reports/restricted.ts fails the two register tests. The label renders in en and ar on TL's register snapshot. F-DG6-341: ADR-0053 now records the shipped acknowledge/resolve rule, and it matches the code. BE-Z8 is sound: 14/14, its mutant fails 7/7, and lock plus FOR UPDATE keep 0101's intent. The sweep passes, and BE-Z7B's four residuals are acceptable. The root P6 journeys pass 174/174 in en and ar, re-running the register's deferred items (A12-5, the A17 failing connector, the S15-014 term scan). New finding F-DG6-400 (Medium, not mandatory, REQ-S10-002): the executive pack's metrics sections, and the executive dashboard report's area metrics, total a restricted benefit's value but carry no includesRestrictedRecords and show no label. For the not-admitted TL, the 2026-09 pack shows planned top line 396000 and forecast top line 148500 SAR, which are exactly that benefit's own lines. The UI shows 'Planned revenue uplift SAR 300.00' with no label in en and ar, while the transformation dashboard labels the same figures. This breaks D-195 Q3 and the ADR-0051 §2 Totals rule. Medium must be repaired before the gate (D-192), hence FAIL.
